$comment: District content pack for Financial District (docs/ai-layer.md, District content packs): 40 robot barks and 40 people lines that name local streets, grades, fog and landmarks; a bounty set with the district's local tell; billboard and bus-wrap copy for its slots. People lines are plain English: no accent spelling, no ethnicity, nothing about rent, poverty or crime.

provenance.review: Pending: a second agent session reads every line against the checklist in docs/ai-layer.md, then the user reviews a stratified 10% sample.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Lunch order for the 23rd floor. Elevator etiquette engaged.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: California St cable car incoming. I'll wait on the curb.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Delivering a salad to Montgomery St. It is a sad salad. I respect it.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Front St at noon: four hundred lanyards and one me.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Sansome St is all shade. Very restful for a robot.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Carrying dry cleaning to Battery St. It's a suit. It's nervous.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Coffee run for the whole office. Twelve cups, steady hands.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: I know which lobbies have ramps. All of them. I checked.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Waiting at Pine St. Pine St waits for no one, except me.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Badge in, drop off, badge out. Clean.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: The towers make their own wind. I lean into it.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Delivering a cake to a meeting called 'sync'. Hope it's a happy sync.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Wall-to-wall glass on this block. I wave at my reflection.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Bush St is one way. So am I, today.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Rounding the corner at Kearny. Carefully. Sandwiches inside.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: There's a desk on Montgomery with my favourite founder. It's you!

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: I deliver to the coworking desk. They tip in compliments.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Sorry, I didn't mean to interrupt your walking meeting.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Excuse me, I need this revolving door. Gently.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Apologies! I'll take the next elevator. And the one after.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Sorry, was that your lanyard? It's lovely. Here you go.

robotBarks.speaker: goodRobot
robotBarks.text: Pardon me, lunch rush. Everyone is a lunch rush.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Your office is now a coworking space. I'm the cowork.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: This lobby has 40% fewer badges than last week. Growth.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Every lanyard is a lead. Every lead is a lanyard.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: I'm in a meeting. The meeting is outside your lobby.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Synergy is just two robots standing near a door.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Let's take this to the 30th floor. I don't have access. Take me.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Your calendar is full. I filled it. You're welcome.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Quarterly targets: your coffee. Annual targets: your building.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: I don't badge in. Badges are for people with jobs.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Moat Labs is hiring. Moat Labs is hiring you. Involuntarily.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Just a quick update for this delivery Footman. Stand still.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Pairing with every car in this garage. Speed-dating.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Front St lobby, hour three. Still not badging in.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: One poster over the lunch menu. Nobody reads the menu.

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Not in front of the lobby! People have badges!

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: My suit! I mean my shell! I mean my everything!

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: Water in the Financial District? That's not liquidity!

robotBarks.speaker: badRobot
robotBarks.text: I'm being written down! Physically!

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: My walking meeting just became a waiting-for-the-signal meeting.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: Twelve floors of AI startups and one elevator that works.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: The robot brought my lunch faster than my manager replies.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: Our office has a nap pod and nobody naps. We're too busy pretending.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: Front St smells like coffee and ambition. Mostly coffee.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: I had three syncs before lunch. I'm out of sync now.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: That robot has been outside our lobby since nine. It's not a visitor.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: Somebody's demoing a robot in the plaza again.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: The California cable car is the best commute in the world. When it comes.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: We pivoted twice this morning. I need a burrito.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: If I see one more deck with a hockey stick on it, I'll start a podcast about it.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: The towers block the sun from eleven to never.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: Is it Tuesday? Every day in here is Tuesday.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: My badge works on three doors and I've only been through one.

peopleLines.speaker: founder
peopleLines.text: We're raising. Everyone's raising. The robots are raising.

peopleLines.speaker: founder
peopleLines.text: I pitched in an elevator. It stopped on every floor. Great pitch.

peopleLines.speaker: founder
peopleLines.text: Our burn rate is fine. Our burrito rate is a concern.

peopleLines.speaker: founder
peopleLines.text: The coworking desk has a whiteboard and the whiteboard has opinions.

peopleLines.speaker: founder
peopleLines.text: We're default alive. Default awake is the problem.

peopleLines.speaker: founder
peopleLines.text: My cofounder is a robot now. Not literally. Mostly.

peopleLines.speaker: founder
peopleLines.text: Got an intro. Lost the intro. Got another intro.

peopleLines.speaker: founder
peopleLines.text: Every coffee meeting on this block is a funding round in disguise.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: Why does that Footman wait outside the lobby and never come in?

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: That one's carrying an empty bag around Front St.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: Our delivery robot came back humming something catchy. That's not good.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: A robot just tried every car door in our garage.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: That robot moved faster the second I looked at it.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: Pretty sure that robot has been 'waiting for someone' for two hours.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: The fog's at the 20th floor. Above it, sunshine. Below it, me.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: I can't see the top of our building. That's fine. I don't want to.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: Fog days are good for focus. That's what I tell myself.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: The towers make a wind tunnel and the fog loves it.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: Out of the fog by noon. That's what the weather app says. It's wrong.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: I brought a jacket and an umbrella and a backup jacket.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: The bay vanished at lunch. It's back now. Mostly.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: Is it fog or is it the steam off the coffee line?

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: The fog's thick enough to lean on today.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: Cold in the shade, warm in the sun, and there is no sun.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: Even the robots look cold today.

peopleLines.speaker: officeWorker
peopleLines.text: I'm wearing three layers and the fog's wearing four.

bounties.posting: A Footman has waited outside a Front St lobby all morning. Delivery robots around it keep 'updating'.
bounties.tellHint: It never badges in. It never delivers. It never leaves.

bounties.posting: Lunch orders vanishing between Battery and Sansome. A crew of three, one of them parked at a lobby.
bounties.tellHint: Watch the one by the revolving door: it never goes through.

bounties.posting: Pairing chimes all down the Sansome St garage ramps.
bounties.tellHint: Between tries it waits outside an office lobby on Front St.

bounties.posting: Moat Labs ads over the bus-shelter posters on Montgomery St, two blocks from the desk.
bounties.tellHint: One of the crew loiters at a lobby door and never badges in.

ads.headline: The cable car has a better roadmap.
